title: Weekly Product Pulse: Feb 16-22, 2026
overview: This week's feedback highlights user appreciation for app simplicity while revealing significant concerns. Critical issues include real-time data bugs leading to losses and high brokerage fees. Users also requested new features like paper trading, indicating a desire for expanded functionality.

themes.name: Glitches & Bugs
themes.summary: Users reported significant dissatisfaction due to critical bugs affecting real-time data, calculations, and display, which led to trading losses and hindered usability.

themes.name: Fees & Charges
themes.summary: Customers expressed strong negative sentiment regarding high brokerage and F&O charges, often finding them disproportionate to earnings and lacking transparency.

themes.name: Unclassified
themes.summary: General feedback showed positive sentiment for simplicity but also indicated a desire for new features like paper trading, alongside some unelaborated dissatisfaction.

quotes: After completing a trade, the balance does not update immediately. Because of this delay and incorrect balance display, I have faced losses.
In total earnings of ₹90, I ended up paying ₹350 as charges.
The mobile app is very simple and user friendly.
actions: Prioritize investigation and resolution of real-time data and calculation inaccuracies to prevent user losses and improve trading.
Review current fee structures and enhance transparency around all charges, especially for F&O and 'extra' costs.
Evaluate demand and feasibility for frequently requested features such as paper trading and advanced charting options.
